title: Warn before a run starts when the slicer merge drivers are not configured

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer s455): landing paused on conflicts in .slicer/render/ROADMAP.html and ROADMAP.md because the clone had no merge.slicer-* git config; the fix (`slicer setup-git` lines, merge --abort, ork retry) came only at the land step, after the whole relay. `slicer check`/`slicer setup-git` exit 1 when the drivers are missing. Wanted: `ork run`/`ork wave start` plans (and `ork doctor`) warn when `slicer setup-git` exits 1 for the project, before any slice starts.
